messages:
anya: Quick syncwe're seeing a new flavor of duplicated provisional tokens when sessions cross regions and reconnect. Looks like our old binary "orig_session present" dedupe isn't enough for cross-region handoffs.
sam: can you summarize what signals we have today?
anya: router may add X-Session-Origin on local handoffs, request-id sometimes preserved, and we can compute content fingerprints. But across regions origin header often drops and request-id gets rewritten for latency.
kevin: proposal: move to a scored merge approach in reconciler. Score combines provenance (origin header), request id match, fingerprint equality, timing, and account match (account match required).
maria: agree but we need clear thresholds and an ops workflow. I suggest: score >= 0.95 -> auto-merge + auto-refund (subject to billing caps). score in [0.7,0.95) -> candidate (manual approve). score < 0.7 -> ignore.
lucy: Console changes: create "Merge Candidates" panel in Cost Explorer for [0.7,0.95) that support can triage. Each card shows: score, evidence tags, merged token delta, sessions, trace link, and approve/deny buttons. Approve triggers billing.merge endpoint.
kevin: reconciler output shape (internal): merge_id (uuid), score (0-1), evidence=[ORIGIN,REQID,FINGERPRINT,TIME_LT_120s], sessions=[s1,s2], merged_tokens (int), trace_id (string). We'll POST to /internal/merge-log in read-only mode first.
anya: billing: what's policy on auto-refunds?
billing-bot: finance allows auto-refund when merged_usd <= 500 and daily_auto_refund_total <= 25k. We'll also throttle at 5/min. Billing will accept merge_proposal with score and decide.
sam: tests: unit for scoring math (edge cases), integration sim cross-region reconnects with missing origin, and e2e for manual-approve flow from Console to billing. Add fuzzy tests where fingerprint slightly differs but tokens match.
maria: telemetry: reconciler.merge_candidate_count, reconciler.merge_auto_count, reconciler.merge_manual_count, merge_score_histogram, evidence_tag_counts. Also add a histogram of time-to-approval for manual merges.
kevin: implementation plan: reconciler.feature.merge_score_v1 behind flag. Phase 1: compute score + write candidates to merge-log (read-only). Phase 2: enable billing POST for high-confidence auto-merges only. Phase 3: enable manual-approve flow in Console.
lucy: UX: show clear tooltip text: "Score = heuristic combining session provenance, request id, content fingerprint, and timing. Higher score = higher confidence this provisional is duplicate." Keep wording short and link to docs.
anya: rollouts: enable flag in canary region -> 1% global -> 10% -> 100% over 72h. During read-only phase show metric card on rollout page with: candidate rate, auto-merge rate (should be 0), manual approvals, false-positive flag (manual_denies / approvals). Auto-disable if false-positive > 1% in 24h.
kevin: edge cases: never merge across different account ids; if fingerprint missing penalize score by 0.25; if request-id matches but origin missing give medium weight.
maria: ops runbook: how to revert merges, refund audit, and how to escalate suspicious spikes. Document manual refund reversal steps and billing logs to inspect.
sam: one more: tie merge candidates to support tickets automatically for score in [0.7,0.9) so CS can proactively check before approving refunds. Add a flag to create ticket webhook only in staging first.
ops-bot: scheduled canary: reconciler-merge-score-v1 -> canary-cluster -> 2024-01-28T02:00Z. /deploy reconciler-merge-score-v1
anya: OK. Kevin will open PRs for reconciler scoring + merge-log writer. Lucy will prototype Console panel. Maria will finalize finance caps and ops runbook. Sam will own tests. We'll monitor merge_score_histogram and manual_denies during canary.
kevin: will include a small toolkit script to re-run scoring offline against historical provisional ledgers to validate thresholds. ETA: PRs in 48h.
anya: thanks all 44d
